title: Long-Context Generation Is a Sampling Problem (When You Turn Up the Heat)
abstract: arXiv:2611.22148v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Open-weight language models are widely observed to get worse the longer they generate. Often, attempts to fix this involve more training. At high temperature, The sampler, i.e. the rule that picks the next token out of the model's probabilities, decides whether long and agentic generation survives and/or thrives. We test 29 open-weight models from 1B to 122B parameters on ten established benchmarks plus needle retrieval out to one million tokens, covering SWE-bench Verified coding agents, long chain-of-thought reasoning, long-form writing, long structured output and long-context reading. Samplers that keep their pool of candidate tokens small and steady as temperature rises don't lose accuracy. Samplers that let in low-probability tokens fall apart. translated_title: 长上下文生成是一个采样问题（当你调高温度时）
translated_abstract: 开源权重语言模型被普遍观察到生成得越长表现越差，而常见的修复尝试往往依赖更多的训练。然而在高温下，采样器——即从模型概率中挑选下一个 token 的规则——决定了长程与智能体式生成能否存活乃至蓬勃发展。我们在十个成熟基准测试以及最长一百万 token 的大海捞针检索任务上，测试了从 1B 到 122B 参数的 29 个开源权重模型，覆盖 SWE-bench Verified 编程智能体、长思维链推理、长篇写作、长结构化输出和长上下文阅读。结果表明：随着温度升高，保持候选 token 池小而稳定的采样器不会损失准确率；而允许低概率 token 进入的采样器则会彻底崩溃。在温度为 2 时，运行 top-p、top-k 或 Top-H 的编程智能体在 100 个 GitHub 问题中解决 0 个，而运行 top-nsigma 的相同智能体可解决 46 到 62 个，并赢得了两种采样器之间的每一次对比。
tldr: 该论文通过大规模实验证明，长上下文生成的退化本质上是采样器问题——高温下保持候选 token 池小而稳定的采样器（如 top-nsigma）能让编程智能体等长程生成任务保持高成功率，而放任低概率 token 进入的采样器则完全崩溃。
en_tdlr: Through large-scale experiments on 29 open-weight models, this paper shows that long-context generation degradation is fundamentally a sampling problem—at high temperature, samplers that keep a small and stable candidate pool (like top-nsigma) sustain long agentic generation, while those admitting low-probability tokens collapse entirely.
